summary: The registered contrast uses 602 deposited cells from 24 litters. The published neuronal result uses 254 selected cells whose individual identities are missing, and its Methods and Figure 2 caption disagree on the treatment counts. Recounting the public matrix against Table S1 localizes the initial QC discrepancy to B19, B21 and L12.

manualReview.summary: L13 is LBN/ELA. Initial QC and final neuronal membership still need the authors’ cell IDs.
manualReview.note: The public count matrix and author supplement match the historical SHA-256 pins. The fresh SOFT gzip differs from its older compressed-file pin, although its GSM titles, ages and deposited conditions reconcile with the matrix and samplesheet. Table S1 supports assigning all 21 L13 cells to ELA and identifies batches as litters. The registered age-adjusted edgeR result uses all 602 cells, summed across 14 control and 10 ELA litters, conserves 775,873,967 counts, and has 237 FDR < 0.05 calls and 687 FDR < 0.1 calls. Counting more than 1,000 positive gene rows gives 514 cells against 511 in Table S1, with one excess each in B19, B21 and L12. The study analyst’s dissertation traces selection from 511 to 430 after Pgr15l exclusion and then to 254 neurons from clusters 2–5. Its Table 3.2 gives directions for 46 selected genes from those neurons. The tested cells cannot be linked individually to the deposited columns using the reviewed records.
reviewFlags: The published Methods give 101 control and 153 ELA neurons, while the Figure 2 caption gives 102 and 152. Exact membership and treatment assignments for the neuronal DE fit remain unresolved.
Table S1 sums to 47 control and 38 ELA pups. The supplement’s dissection text gives 50 and 38. Both sources support 14 control and 10 ELA litters, the registered units of replication.

verificationReview.reason: The available treatment directions and figures refer to a selected 254-neuron cohort. The registered output uses all deposited cell types pooled by litter. Table S1 gives litter totals only, and the two published arm counts for the final neuronal test conflict. Author-concordance-v2 cohort compatibility cannot be established for the registered output.
verificationReview.nextStep: Ask for the GEO matrix-column IDs or GSMs for the initial 511 cells and the 254 cells used in Figure 2 DE, including each cell’s litter, rearing arm, Pgr15l exclusion and cluster. Ask which feature definition and filter order reconcile B19, B21 and L12 and which control/ELA split entered the fit. Use that map for a separately scoped author-cohort analysis. A direct registered-output comparison requires an author reference for the all-cell litter contrast.
